observation: Manual picks around exposed large mounting-hole opening rims at the cable and ROM ends. Pick the opening boundary, not the displaced wood/background boundary or the outer solder/coating ring.
uncertaintyScope: Conservative visual picking allowance per coordinate, not a measured confidence interval or manufacturing roundness bound.
hypothesis: The photographed opening rims are approximately circular in the board plane. No diameter or equality of hole sizes is assumed. Board thickness, bevels, damage, lens distortion and rim-selection bias can violate this hypothesis.
scope: Independent shape screen for existing conditional registrations, not a fitted anchor, a manufacturing specification or authorization to move pads. Retain ambiguous candidates when the picking allowance cannot distinguish them.
